Boundaries.Name: typed-dispatch-owner
Boundaries.Contract: Start ownership before disposal, route selection, command validation and cache fences. Native conversion, primary/replica/cluster ready sends and transparent retries borrow this owner.

Boundaries.Name: string-dispatch-owner
Boundaries.Contract: Own string dispatch before preflight through response consumption; every ready route shares the same failure-only lease.

Boundaries.Name: bytes-dispatch-owner
Boundaries.Contract: Own byte dispatch before preflight through response consumption; copied discarded-reply metadata outlives caller ownership.
